```

```

"a plain string"

```{er2}
#| echo: false
class Table:
    def _repr_html_(self):
        return "<table class='er2-html-table'><tr><td>HTML_CELL</td></tr></table>"
    def __repr__(self):
        return "PLAIN_TABLE"

Table()
```
